title: Johnny Dunn
summary: Scott recalls Johnny Dunn of Hot Chocolates.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles

blocks.x: You didn't mention at all about Johnny Dunn.

Yeah, old Johnny Dunn. I knew Johnny, a trumpet player, yeah. He was a tall fellow, brown skin, and nice looking. He was in -- oh, what's the name of that show? Hot Chocolates. Yeah, Hot Chocolates. He was in that show, yeah.
Yeah, he was very popular, wasn't he?
But he didn't last long. He didn't last long. Johnny -- yeah, he came up and he was popping that

show, but after that you didn't hear much of Johnny. And the first thing I know, he just disappeared. And we didn't know where he went. And somebody said he died, but it wasn't verified, I don't know.
Well, I know he went to Europe for awhile.
Yeah, he went to Europe, and he just lost contact with the main guys and all like that. Johnny Dunn was a nice trumpet player, years ago, yeah. So, I left Chick and here comes -- where was I?
